notes: Alert box (v2.46.0): Important Alerts ab aik asli box hai — amber-tinted card, har alert apni row mein (severity icon + bold title + aik saaf summary line, lafz ki had par kata hua), aur UPDATE_AVAILABLE alerts par asli 'Update Now' button jo Settings ke Updates tab par le jata hai. Lambi manifest notes ab row mein nahi aati — poori tafseel alert ke apne click se milti hai. Koi data/API change nahi.
